sentences.text: For a Primary Urban Co-operative Bank, penal interest is not permitted, and any penalty for non-compliance of loan terms must be treated as penal charges rather than added to the rate of interest.
The home-loan document states a penal charge of ₹500 per month of default, and it does not on its face say that this charge is penal interest or added to the loan’s interest rate.

On the evidence provided, I cannot say this clause violates RBI’s prohibition on penal interest, because the document describes a penal charge and the cited RBI rule prohibits penal interest, not penal charges as such.

missing.slot: whether the ₹500 charge is actually added to the rate of interest or is charged separately
missing.searched: Reviewed the home-loan KFS penalty line and the RBI rule on penal interest versus penal charges; no document says the ₹500 monthly amount is added to the interest rate.
